title: backlog.py show prints an item's chosen fields, or its version at a git ref, as plain JSON, so no session pipes git show into python
goal: show ID --json prints only the item file's JSON object; show ID --field F (repeatable) prints a JSON object of only those fields and an unknown field exits 2 naming the allowed ones; show ID --ref REF reads the item from that git ref and exits 1 naming the ref when it holds no such file

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
def item(i,**k):
 d=dict(id=i,kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]);d.update(k)
 (r/"items"/(i+".json")).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n")
def commit():g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk");env.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG",None)
def run(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
item("ST-aaaaaaaa",gates=[{"id":"g1","kind":"provisional","question":"q","options":["a","b"],"recommendation":"b"}]);commit()
g("checkout","-q","-b","work/ST-aaaaaaaa");item("ST-aaaaaaaa",title="branch title");commit();g("checkout","-q","-")
a=run("show","ST-aaaaaaaa","--json");b=run("show","ST-aaaaaaaa","--field","title","--field","status","--ref","work/ST-aaaaaaaa")
c=run("show","ST-aaaaaaaa","--field","nope");d=run("show","ST-aaaaaaaa","--json","--ref","nobranch")
print(a.returncode,b.returncode,c.returncode,d.returncode,b.stdout[-120:],(c.stdout+c.stderr)[-160:])
ok=a.returncode==0 and json.loads(a.stdout)["title"]=="t" and b.returncode==0 and json.loads(b.stdout)=={"title":"branch title","status":"todo"}
ok=ok and c.returncode==2 and "status" in c.stdout+c.stderr and d.returncode==1 and "nobranch" in d.stdout+d.stderr
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: show ID --json prints only the item file's JSON object
show ID --field F (repeatable) prints a JSON object of only those fields and an unknown field exits 2 naming the allowed ones
show ID --ref REF reads the item from that git ref and exits 1 naming the ref when it holds no such file

gates.question: What does show print with --ref alone, and for an allowed field the item lacks?
options: ref alone prints the whole item JSON only; an allowed field the item lacks is left out
ref alone prints the full text view from the ref; a missing allowed field prints null
